findings.message: Clickable <span> is not keyboard operable. Use a <button> instead.
findings.whoIsAffected: Keyboard users cannot reach or operate this control.

fix.description: Use a <button type="button"> instead of a clickable div or span.
fix.diff: --- a/apps/demo/before/app/dashboard/page.tsx +++ b/apps/demo/before/app/dashboard/page.tsx @@ -1,1 +1,1 @@ - {}}>Clear filters +

findings.message: Icon-only button has no accessible name.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen reader users hear a control with no useful name.

fix.description: Add aria-label, or a <span className="sr-only"> with the action name.
fix.diff:
--- a/apps/demo/before/app/dashboard/page.tsx	
+++ b/apps/demo/before/app/dashboard/page.tsx	
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-      <button type="button" className="size-5">
+      <button aria-label="Describe this action" type="button" className="size-5">

findings.message: Image has no alt attribute.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen reader users cannot tell what the image is, or that it is there.

fix.description: Add an alt attribute that describes the image, or alt="" if it is decorative.
fix.diff: --- a/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx +++ b/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx @@ -1,1 +1,1 @@ - +

fix.description: Add aria-label, or a <span className="sr-only"> with the action name.

findings.message: Page or layout has no metadata.title or generateMetadata.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen reader and browser users cannot tell which page or view they are on.

fix.description: Export metadata with a unique title, or export generateMetadata.

findings.message: Clickable target is 20×20 CSS pixels, under the 24px minimum.
findings.whoIsAffected: People with limited precision, tremors, or who tap on a phone have a harder time hitting the control.

fix.description: Raise the fixed size to at least 24px (size-6, h-6 w-6) or add padding that brings the target to 24px.
fix.diff:
--- a/apps/demo/before/app/dashboard/page.tsx	
+++ b/apps/demo/before/app/dashboard/page.tsx	
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-      <button type="button" className="size-5">
+      <button type="button" className="size-6">

findings.message: <html> is missing a lang attribute.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen readers may pronounce the page in the wrong language.

fix.description: Set lang on <html>, for example <html lang="en">.
fix.diff:
--- a/apps/demo/before/app/layout.tsx	
+++ b/apps/demo/before/app/layout.tsx	
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-    <html>
+    <html lang="en">

findings.message: Image alt is a filename ("banner.png"), not a description.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen reader users hear a filename instead of a description.

fix.description: Replace the filename alt with a short description of the image.
fix.diff: --- a/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx +++ b/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx @@ -1,1 +1,1 @@ - +

findings.message: Image alt is a generic word ("image"), not a description.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen reader users hear a generic word instead of what the image shows.

fix.description: Replace the generic alt with a short description of the image.
fix.diff:
--- a/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx	
+++ b/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx	
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-      <Image src="/photo.jpg" alt="image" width={960} height={540} />

findings.message: Focus outline is removed without a focus-visible:ring or focus-visible:outline replacement.
findings.whoIsAffected: Keyboard users cannot see which element has focus.

fix.description: Add focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2, or another focus-visible outline.
fix.diff:
--- a/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx	
+++ b/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx	
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-      <button className="outline-none">Get started</button>
+      <button className="focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 outline-none">Get started</button>

findings.message: Icon-only link has no accessible name.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen reader users hear a link with no useful destination when links are read out of context.

fix.description: Add an aria-label or a <span className="sr-only"> that names the destination.
fix.diff:
--- a/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx	
+++ b/apps/demo/before/app/page.tsx	
@@ -1,1 +1,1 @@
-      <Link href="/settings">
+      <Link aria-label="Describe the destination" href="/settings">

findings.message: Form control has no label. Placeholder text is not a label.
findings.whoIsAffected: Screen reader users are not told what to enter. A placeholder disappears while typing and is not a label.

fix.description: Add a Label with htmlFor matching the control id, aria-label, or a FormLabel inside the same FormItem.
fix.diff:
--- a/apps/demo/before/app/register/page.tsx	
+++ b/apps/demo/before/app/register/page.tsx	
@@ -1,1 +1,2 @@
-      <Input placeholder="Email" />
+<Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
+      <Input id="email" placeholder="Email" />

--- a/apps/demo/before/components/delete-dialog.tsx

manualChecks.notes: Complete the main task using only the keyboard.
Confirm tab order follows the visual order.
Confirm focus stays inside an open dialog, sheet, or drawer.
Confirm Escape closes the topmost dialog and restores focus.
Confirm alt text describes the purpose of the image, not only that an attribute exists.
Confirm status messages are announced without stealing focus.
Confirm sticky headers and footers do not cover the focused element.
Confirm the page still works at 200% zoom.
